81211.body:
Forbes Edge

Автор: Forbes


Автор: Forbes

Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/ai-everywhere-work-2026clarity-still-lacking-forbes-magazine-busdc?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3B1pPLOK1OTVKDrbaRqw5IWA%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=2XPvurfQoZUss1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mvi6myyd~p8-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mvi6myyd-p8
  
Many of today’s business leaders remember what happened to the organizations that failed to adapt to the internet revolution. They’re so afraid of falling behind that some may be repeating the very mistake they’re trying to avoid: investing in technology before developing a clear strategy for using it. FOMO-driven investment in AI tools, training and transformation initiatives is high. Companies are teaching employees to drive but have no idea where the car should be going. According to a 2025 Cisco report, 54% of CEOs acknowledge that fear of missing out drives their technology investment decisions. Consequently, employees are struggling to understand what AI means for their work and career development. Only 27% of executives have a comprehensive AI strategy, and just 20% believe their workforce is truly AI-ready, a recent Gartner study found. Effective AI adoption requires clarity, communication, and trust—not just tools and training. Employees need to know why AI matters, what their role is and what success with the technology looks like. This growing chasm between technological ambition and human readiness may reduce the productivity gains companies are seeking. AI-generated workslop is one example. Research shows that 40% of workers have encountered AI-generated content that looks complete but requires substantial correction. That can cost employees approximately two hours per incident. If companies truly want to maximize the power of AI, they need to figure out where the car is going and let their employees know before they press down harder on the gas pedal.  — William Arruda, Senior Contributor WORK SMARTER  Practical insights and advice from Forbes staff and contributors to help you succeed in your job, accelerate your career and lead smarter. 81208.subject: PropAMMs: Ethereum vs Solana
81208.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

PropAMMs were created and are popular on Solana and emerging on Ethereum. Let’s take a snapshot of where things stand, but first: what is a propAMM (Proprietary Automated Market Maker)? A PropAMM is an onchain trading system where a protocol uses an offchain pricing engine and oracle feeds to actively reprice its liquidity. Unlike traditional AMMs that rely on fixed mathematical curves and passive user-funded pools, propAMMs function like active, private market makers. 

If they’re actively repriced and use private market makers, then why are they called AMMs? No clue, but PropAMM volume share on Ethereum has reached ~14% (peaked at 22% for one day in August).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e873ffdf-a931-44b9-975d-98be61818189/image.png?t=1792578404)
Caption: 

Compared to their ~36% volume share on Solana, Ethereum PropAMMs are actually not that far off. However, in absolute terms, Solana PropAMMs record $5 billion+ in weekly volume vs. the $500 million seen on Ethereum. That’s a ~10x difference. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/491160b0-3b06-4b97-b835-d2efcdf55afb/image.png?t=1792578404)
Caption: 

Another material difference is the dominant asset pairs being traded. On Ethereum, ~60 to 70% of PropAMM volume stems from stablecoin pairs vs 6 to 12% on Solana. Ethereum is home to over 100 stablecoins worth over $140 billion (vs ~50 worth $17 billion on Solana).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/56768001-9994-4c6b-b86c-dc73c2848208/image.png?t=1792578405)
Caption: 

Despite that order of magnitude more supply, Solana still handles double the monthly stablecoin volume (albeit the gap is closing).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b020fa3c-0c34-4c4b-bbd8-8ffbb310f020/image.png?t=1792578405)
Caption: 

For native asset pairs (SOL and ETH), the story is different. Nearly 70% of PropAMM volume on Solana stems from SOL/USDC vs 25% for ETH/stablecoin on Ethereum. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/620e2918-8ce2-49fe-9345-710f914a42c6/image.png?t=1792578405)
Caption: 

On Ethereum, Fermiswap is the dominant PropAMM with ~60% volume share (though Metric is regaining lost ground).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8f3cd4b8-87e1-4fe5-8a14-3a08c9bae9
